scope: Preimplementation canon, determinism, formation-state ownership, save compatibility, and validation review of the proved fractional formation-fatigue persistence defect. No source, test, gameplay, package, scenario, native, build, baseline, or canon document was changed by this review.

established_facts.lossy_boundary: src/state/serialize.ts:13-37 deep-clones then reapplies migrations from schema_version 0; src/state/save_migration.ts:186-215 resets every non-integer formation fatigue to 0.
established_facts.desktop_effect: The desktop serializes runtime state after each Advance and deserializes it before the next Advance, so the integer-only migration commits the loss between turns.
established_facts.headless_effect: The scenario runner carries the live nextState between weeks, so its in-memory fractional value survives even though emitted saves pass through serialization.
established_facts.actual_turn16_observation: Foča fatigue 10.5 and Gacko fatigue 2.5 become 0 at the seam; Nevesinje 4 and Čajniče 8 remain unchanged. The retained characterization found 25 fractional fatigue reset paths overall.
established_facts.consumer_relevance: Commander force evaluation reads fatigue as a continuous numeric multiplier. The retained evidence proves an operand change, not an actual week-17 rank, selected brigade, map change, or 705 causation.
established_facts.unrelated_fields: The relevant four formations had no accompanying personnel, cohesion, morale, readiness, kind, activation, or location change.

canon_mapping.change: Preserve finite non-negative fractional formation.ops.fatigue through migration, canonical serialization, runtime serialization, and load.
canon_mapping.mapping: Save/load must fully reconstruct formation state; resetting 10.5 or 2.5 to zero violates this requirement.

canon_mapping.change: Keep desktop state durable without changing its value at the serialization boundary.
canon_mapping.mapping: The serialized/autosaved desktop state must be the successful mutation's actual state, including persisted fatigue.

canon_mapping.change: Treat formation fatigue as persisted gameplay truth rather than a derived cache.
canon_mapping.mapping: The manual names formation state and a fractional frontline-fatigue mechanism, while enumerating the five disposable military caches; formations/ops are not in that transient list.

canon_mapping.change: Retain deterministic serializer behavior while accepting valid fractions.
canon_mapping.mapping: Finite IEEE-754 values are deterministic JSON inputs; this predicate correction adds no time, randomness, collection iteration, or ordering change.

approved_production_scope.required_change: In defaultFormations only, replace the integer-only fatigue guard with an explicit number, finite, non-negative guard. Preserve every typeof-number value for which Number.isFinite(value) and value >= 0; default missing, non-number, NaN, positive or negative infinity, and negative values to 0. Do not round, clamp, rescale, or create a new state field.
Correct only the stale FormationOpsState.fatigue annotation so it states finite non-negative persisted numeric fatigue and permits fractional values. Do not alter the interface shape.

Align formations.ops.fatigue validation with the migration and writer: accept finite numbers >= 0, including fractions; reject non-number, NaN, infinities, and negative values. Update the diagnostic message accordingly without changing issue ordering or code.

explicit_exclusions: No change to src/state/formation_fatigue.ts, FRONTLINE_FATIGUE_PER_TURN, FATIGUE_RECOVERY_INTERVAL, FATIGUE_MAX, combat fatigue deltas, recovery, supply, or ordering.
No change to militia-pool fatigue, src/state/militia_fatigue.ts, defaultMilitiaPools, or MilitiaPoolState's integer contract.
No change to commander thresholds, force evaluation formulas, candidate eligibility, selection, control, terrain, battles, operations, cohesion, morale, formation creation, or player policy.
No change to schema version, serialized field shape, state ownership, transient-field list, save format, or canonical key ordering.
No change to front_posture_commitment.ts or integer-only scenario/CLI reporting guards in this repair; those are separate consumer-contract questions and cannot be silently bundled.
No baseline adoption, threshold relaxation, map acceptance waiver, tuning, or claim that this defect caused the retained 705 result.

save_compatibility.reason: The field already exists as number and the live producer already writes fractions. The repair corrects an invalid normalization predicate without changing shape or adding a field.
save_compatibility.legacy_missing_ops: Still defaults to { fatigue: 0, last_supplied_turn: null }.
save_compatibility.legacy_missing_or_malformed_fatigue: Still defaults to 0 for absent, non-number, non-finite, or negative values.
save_compatibility.legacy_integer_fatigue: Must serialize and deserialize byte-identically to the current implementation.
save_compatibility.valid_fractional_fatigue: Must survive canonical and runtime serialization/deserialization exactly.
save_compatibility.old_save_effect: A legacy/current save that already contains a valid finite non-negative fraction must retain it instead of losing it; a save already written with a lossy zero cannot reconstruct the lost historical value.

determinism_review.risk: Expected canonical/runtime bytes change only where the old migration erased valid fractional fatigue. Every changed byte must be attributable to the authorized values or directly derived provenance/hash metadata.

red: Under the unmodified predicate, prove 10.5 and 2.5 become 0 across the real canonical/runtime preparation path and that validateFormations rejects them.
Retain the RED receipt/result separately; do not rewrite it after GREEN.
green: For RBiH, RS, and HRHB formations, preserve representative 0.5, 2.5, and 10.5 values exactly through deserializeState(serializeState(state)) and deserializeState(serializeRuntimeState(state)).
Exercise applyFatigueRecovery on the real front-assigned path from an integer value so production creates a half point, then require exact canonical and runtime round-trip preservation.
Require repeated canonical and runtime serialization to be byte-identical and require serialization not to mutate the input object.
Require existing integer values, including 0, 4, and 8, to retain existing serialized bytes and validation behavior.

Require absent ops and missing fatigue to default to 0; require strings, objects, null where invalid, NaN, positive infinity, negative infinity, and negative numbers to retain fail-closed migration behavior and validator rejection where directly validated.
Prove militia-pool fractional fatigue remains rejected/defaulted under its existing integer-only contract.

Use loadStateFromPath with a real current-shape save containing fractional formation fatigue, then compare a production advance from the loaded/runtime-roundtripped state against the same valid source state under identical baseDir and inputs: full resulting state and report must match exactly.
Exercise all three factions in the persistence and next-advance fixtures; do not infer all-faction coverage from one RBiH player label.
actual_retained_snapshot_proof: Run a separate ignored evidence check against raw-turn16.NOT_GAME_SAVE.v8; tracked CI tests must not depend on the private ignored packet path.
Require all 25 observed fractional formation-fatigue reset paths to retain their exact raw values through canonical and runtime round trips.
Require Foča 10.5 and Gacko 2.5 exact, with Nevesinje 4 and Čajniče 8 unchanged; inventory any remaining state-path changes rather than hiding them behind aggregate equality.
static_gates: Focused Vitest RED then GREEN with exact test and assertion counts.
node --check for any changed/generated CJS evidence helpers only.
git diff --check exit 0 and independent postimplementation source/test review.

bounded_prefix_gate.scope: One authentic observer-backed 0-to-16 prefix at the reviewed candidate; no week 17.
pass_conditions: Same scenario, input digest, terrain bindings, clean HEAD, source bindings, turn count, and 16 callbacks.
Exact initial state fidelity and unchanged ordinary control, battle, operation, and report semantics through turn 16.
All 25 fractional fatigue resets disappear; exact Foča/Gacko fractions survive and the two named integer controls remain unchanged.
No unrelated state presence/value difference appears across the serialization seam.
Decoded old/new canonical and runtime output differences are confined to authorized persisted formation-fatigue values and directly derived hash/provenance metadata.
bounded_prefix_gate.expected_hash_policy: The old turn-16 canonical hash encoded lossy zeroes and is expected to move. Preserve the old artifact and its old-scope byte-identity claim; record a new candidate hash and prove the semantic diff instead of waiving or relabeling the old claim.
bounded_prefix_gate.stop: Stop on any unrelated state, gameplay, control, battle, operation, report, input, or artifact drift. A pass does not prove week-17 or 707 causation.

unaffected_evidence_reuse: The retained diagnosis, canon mapping, historical/map authority, old failures, and old candidate evidence remain valid at their stated heads and scopes.
Old package/native evidence remains historical evidence only and cannot qualify binaries containing this source delta.
new_candidate_required: After focused GREEN, typecheck, bounded prefix, and independent implementation review, create a clean committed/pushed candidate with terminal CI.

Run the authoritative 188-week scenario first under the existing one-attempt/fail-closed contract. Require 707/707/706/706, zero formerly-correct n91/n92 losses at all four checkpoints, protected anchors, provenance, telemetry, preservation, and all existing acceptance gates.

Only a qualifying scenario candidate proceeds to the required full suite. The old 2ca scenario/full-suite results do not qualify the gameplay-affecting serialization delta, though their unaffected diagnostic history remains reusable.
Build a fresh package from the qualifying candidate and prove inventory, compiled-source mapping, save/load preservation, cold source/package consumer equality, and independent package approval.
Run a fresh normal native opening prerequisite and then the single authorized native39 qualification under existing practical gates, preservation, no-retry, and provenance rules.
final_acceptance: Headless checkpoint maps and all protected calibration gates remain required; no expected save-hash movement waives a map or score loss.
The repair may be accepted as the persistence correction only after its semantic and broad regression gates pass.

The ordinary-player capability goal remains unmet unless the fresh normal native39 proof reaches 707 and retains every formerly-correct cell and practical gate. A continued 705 or any new loss is a failed qualification, not evidence for tuning or baseline adoption.

It does not block the coefficient-agnostic persistence repair because both values are fractional and the repair changes neither writer nor mechanic. Any future coefficient reconciliation is a separate canon/tuning decision with its own evidence.

Migration and validator predicates are identical in accepted domain and malformed rejection.
Focused RED/GREEN evidence, all-faction coverage, retained raw snapshot proof, desktop load/next-advance equality, typecheck, and diff cleanliness.
